name: codex-profile
description: ThumbGate for Codex turns one thumbs-down into a repeat-blocking pre-action check, backed by local MCP memory.

interface.shortDescription: Turn one thumbs-down into a repeat-blocking pre-action check.
interface.longDescription: Adds a local ThumbGate MCP server to Codex so explicit thumbs-up/down feedback can become prevention rules. Check risky commands, edits, deploys, publishes, PR actions, Sites deploys, role-plugin writes, and Agentic OS operating-file changes before they run, then reuse the lesson across future sessions instead of relying on prompt memory alone.
defaultPrompt: Use ThumbGate to check prevention gates before I run a deploy, publish, PR, or destructive command.
Capture this thumbs-down with the file, command, and behavior to block next time.
Show the current ThumbGate lessons that apply before editing this repo.
Run the ThumbGate feedback self-test and verify the loop before claiming it works.
